rules.message: wait() deprecated hai; task.wait() use karo
spawn() deprecated hai; task.spawn() use karo
delay() deprecated hai; task.delay() use karo
Instance.new ka 2nd (parent) argument avoid karo; properties set karke last me .Parent set karo
workspace global ya game:GetService('Workspace') use karo
getfenv/setfenv Luau me discouraged hain, optimizations todte hain
loadstring default me disabled hota hai (ServerScriptService.LoadStringEnabled)
table.getn Luau me nahi hai; #t use karo
unpack() ki jagah table.unpack() use karo
tick() deprecated; os.time(), os.clock() ya workspace:GetServerTimeNow() use karo
while true do loop me task.wait() zaroor ho, warna script exhaust ho jayegi
